verdict.summary: Every hard requirement is met and verified: 8 SVGs (sun, cloud, rain, wind, fog, high-tide, low-tide, moon), 24 grid, stroke only with root stroke=currentColor, round caps, no fill, 611-929 bytes each; preview.html shows all eight at true 24 and 48 px on a light and a dark panel, from file://, no network. All eight are nameable at 24 px. The owner's two notes are honoured: crests are uneven, the eight rays differ in length and angle. On the look: at 48 px it reads as pen-drawn (slow bends, open ends, overshoots, no symmetry); at 24 px it reads as a tidy outline set with a slight wobble. It's clearly not the geometric icon-pack look, but it's a gentle hand, not a scratchy field-notebook sketch. Low tide differs from high tide mainly by the chevron direction; its water is only slightly lower.
